text:
After all—but after all—

it's only a matter of lying down together,

a matter of flesh,

of naked bodies,

the lamp of death in the world.


Glory with its throat slit, survivor

of deaf-mute time,

paltry pay for those who die together.


To the misery of pleasure, eternity,

you condemned the search, to unjust

failure you chained thirst,

you nailed the heart to a wall.


It is a matter of my body, which I bless,

against which I fight,

which must give me everything

in a stout silence

and which often dies and kills.


Solitude, mark me with your bare foot,

press my heart like grapes

and fill my mouth with its ripe liquor.

translation.title: After All
